review_notes: I read the whole target file and the relevant parts of MonoidAlgebra.lean (liftGroupLikeCoalgHom, its toLinearMap lemma, range lemma). I also considered the shared "rewrite x as f (symm x)" step in comul_eq_sum_spanCoefficients and counit_eq_sum_spanCoefficients. It is only a short rewrite plus a naturality lemma, so I did not report it. The proposed lemma's exact form and the simp normal forms in the rewrites are untested. The existing lemma liftGroupLikeCoalgHom_toLinearMap is rfl, so the new pointwise lemma should be a one-line LinearMap.congr_fun.

findings.problem: The pointwise identity `liftGroupLikeCoalgHom f x = Finsupp.linearCombination K (fun g => (f g).val) (coeffLinearEquiv K x)` is re-derived in three places. These are the injectivity branch (l.124), the surjectivity branch (l.130–143), and `spanCoalgebraEquiv_toLinearEquiv` (l.181–186). Each time it is rebuilt from `liftGroupLikeCoalgHom_toLinearMap` using `LinearMap.congr_fun` or a long `simpa only [CoalgHom.toLinearMap_eq_coe, CoalgHom.coe_toLinearMap, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, id_eq, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]` call. The surjectivity branch also needs a nested `calc` inside `simpa ... using`. The reader has to re-check each time that the three blocks say the same thing, and a change to the simp set would have to be made in each.
findings.proposed_change:
State the evaluation formula once, either in MonoidAlgebra.lean next to `liftGroupLikeCoalgHom_toLinearMap` or in this file before `spanCoalgebraEquiv`:

`theorem liftGroupLikeCoalgHom_apply_eq_linearCombination (f : G → GroupLike R C) (x : R[G]) : liftGroupLikeCoalgHom f x = Finsupp.linearCombination R (fun g => (f g).val) (coeffLinearEquiv R x) := LinearMap.congr_fun (liftGroupLikeCoalgHom_toLinearMap f) x`

The proof is a single `LinearMap.congr_fun` because the existing lemma is `rfl`.

Rewritten uses:
1. Injectivity: from `h'` (ambient equality of the evaluations), `rw [liftGroupLikeCoalgHom_apply_eq_linearCombination, liftGroupLikeCoalgHom_apply_eq_linearCombination] at h'` gives exactly the goal for `linearIndep_groupLikeVal`, namely equality of `linearCombination`s of `coeffLinearEquiv x` and `coeffLinearEquiv y`.
2. Surjectivity: after `Subcoalgebra.coe_injective`, the goal is `rw [liftGroupLikeCoalgHom_apply_eq_linearCombination, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]; exact (linearIndep_groupLikeVal).linearCombination_repr x`. The nested `calc` goes away.
3. `spanCoalgebraEquiv_toLinearEquiv`: the third `calc` step becomes `liftGroupLikeCoalgHom_apply_eq_linearCombination _ x`.

No new imports are needed. The lemma is stated for a general family, so `f = id` is a special case.
findings.benefit: The unfolding of the evaluation map into a linear combination is proved once and named. The bijectivity proof and the linear-equivalence identification then each read as short rewrites. The same lemma is available to other users of `liftGroupLikeCoalgHom`, and the long `simpa only` lists no longer need to be kept in sync.
